Name: PersonalDimension
Author: MoYuCSC
Description:
[heading][size=4][b]📖 Mod Description[/b][/size][/heading]
[size=4][b]PersonalDimension is a Stardew Valley mod that provides players with an infinite categorized storage space accessible from anywhere in the game world—whether you're on the farm, in the mines, at the desert, on Ginger Island, or even at a festival.
✨ Features
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Unlimited Storage：No capacity limit. Store as many items as you want—say goodbye to overflowing chests.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Auto-Categorization：Items are automatically sorted into categories based on their type for easy management.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]One-Click Access：Left-click to take entire stacks from the dimension, right-click to take single items. Click items in your backpack to deposit them instantly.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Access Anywhere：The item is always in your inventory. Right-click it to open the dimension anytime, anywhere.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Multiplayer Shared Storage：All players in the same save share the same dimension—you put items in, your teammates can take them out. Perfect for co-op play.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Rich Categories：Supports Crops (Flowers, Honey), Seeds, Fish (Roe), Artisan, Tools, Clothing, Weapons, Furniture, Crafting, Resources, and more.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Page Navigation & Hover Tooltips：Scroll to flip pages or use the page buttons. Hover over items to view detailed information.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]How to Obtain：Unlock the recipe at Farming Level 5. Craft with 5 Prismatic Shards + 100 Iridium Bars.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]📦 Crafting Recipe


[/b][/size]
[table][tr][th][size=4][b]Material[/b][/size][/th]
[th][size=4][b]Amount[/b][/size][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Prismatic Shard[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4][b]5[/b][/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Iridium Bar[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4][b]100[/b][/size][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][size=4][b]Unlock Condition：Farming Level 5
🎮 How to Use
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][b]Craft the「Personal Dimension」item from the crafting menu.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Right-click the item in your inventory to open the dimension interface.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Select a category on the left to view corresponding items.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Left-click an item in the dimension → take the entire stack. Right-click → take one.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Click an item in your backpack → it will be automatically stored and categorized.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Use the scroll wheel or page buttons to navigate between pages.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]🌐 Multi-Language Support
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]English[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Simplified Chinese[/b][/size][/*]
[/list]🎉 Update Summary
1. UI Improvements
[list]
[*][b]Item Slot Backgrounds[/b]: Added dark semi-transparent backgrounds for dimension items, making them visually clearer and consistent with the vanilla backpack style.[/*]
[*][b]Adjustable Grid Layout[/b]: Support for customizing items per row (default 12 columns), making it easier for players with different screen sizes to adjust.[/*]
[*][b]Page Display & Navigation Buttons[/b]: Support for scrolling with mouse wheel and clicking page buttons, with current page/total pages display.[/*]
[*][b]Centered Button Text[/b]: Category button text is now centered for a cleaner look.[/*]
[/list]2. One-Click Operations
[list]
[*][b]Deposit All[/b]: Deposit all backpack items in the current category into the dimension (blacklisted items excluded).[/*]
[*][b]Withdraw All[/b]: Withdraw all dimension items in the current category to the backpack (until backpack is full).[/*]
[*][b]Button Placement[/b]: Deposit button is located at the top-right of the backpack, Withdraw button at the bottom-right of the dimension grid – they don't interfere with each other.[/*]
[/list]3. Auto-Deposit Feature
[list]
[*][b]Category-Level Auto-Deposit[/b]: Each category can independently enable auto-deposit (controlled by checkboxes).[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Deposit with Ring[/b]: Even without carrying the Personal Dimension item, wearing the Dimension Ring allows auto-deposit to function.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Deposit Interception[/b]: Items taken from the dimension won't trigger auto-deposit, preventing infinite loops.[/*]
[*][b]Blacklist Interception[/b]: Blacklisted items are excluded from auto-deposit, one-click deposit, and manual deposit.[/*]
[/list]4. Blacklist System
[list]
[*][b]Independent Tab[/b]: Blacklist appears as a separate category at the bottom of the category list.[/*]
[*][b]Add to Blacklist[/b]: Switch to the blacklist tab, left-click an item in your backpack to add it to the blacklist (only records the item info, doesn't consume the item).[/*]
[*][b]Remove from Blacklist[/b]: In the blacklist tab, right-click a blacklisted item to remove it.[/*]
[*][b]Global Interception[/b]: Blacklisted items cannot be deposited into the dimension through any method (auto-deposit, one-click deposit, or manual deposit).[/*]
[/list]5. Dimension Ring
[list]
[*][b]New Item[/b]: Crafting recipe is 4 Iridium Rings + 1 Personal Dimension item, unlocked at Farming Level 5.[/*]
[*][b]Wearing Effect[/b]: When equipped, pressing the hotkey (default Ctrl+V) opens the dimension without needing to hold the Personal Dimension item.[/*]
[*][b]Right-Click to Use[/b]: Right-click the ring in your backpack to open the dimension directly (won't equip the ring).[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Deposit Support[/b]: While wearing the ring, auto-deposit works as long as the corresponding category is enabled.[/*]
[*][b]Hotkey Toggle[/b]: Pressing the hotkey again closes the dimension menu.[/*]
[/list]6. Configurable Hotkeys
[list]
[*]Supports customizing hotkeys and modifier keys (Ctrl/Shift/Alt) via the 
[code]config.json[/code] file.[/*]
[*]Default hotkey is 
[code]Ctrl+V[/code] to avoid conflicts with game's built-in shortcuts.[/*]
[/list]7. Compatibility & Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed duplicate item stack number rendering.[/*]
[*]Fixed incomplete item slot backgrounds.[/*]
[*]Fixed auto-deposit causing items to be repeatedly deposited.[/*]
[*]Fixed ring not opening dimension on right-click.[/*]
[*]Fixed hotkey being intercepted by the game.[/*]
[*]Improved item categorization logic (added Clothing, Resources, etc.).[/*]
[*][heading]🍳 Cooking & Crafting Integration[/heading]
When you open the [b]Cooking[/b] or [b]Crafting[/b] interface, the mod will [b]automatically check[/b] your personal dimension for any materials required by the current recipe.
[list]
[*]If your backpack is short on materials, the system will [b]automatically pull the missing items[/b] from your personal dimension.[/*]
[*][b]No extra button presses are required[/b]—everything happens seamlessly in the background.[/*]
[*]Simply select a recipe and craft as usual; the mod intelligently handles material sourcing.[/*]
[/list][b]Note[/b]: Blacklisted items will never be automatically taken out, keeping your valuable items safe.[/*]
[*]The construction space is now connected—the items within it will automatically fulfill building requirements. Despite displaying red numbers (indicating insufficient resources), construction is still possible.[/*]
[/list][heading]English Version[/heading]
New Features
1. Whitelist System
[list]
[*]Complete whitelist functionality with toggle switch.[/*]
[*]Operates independently from blacklist.[/*]
[*]When enabled, only whitelisted items will be auto-deposited.[/*]
[/list]2. Independent Blacklist/Whitelist UI
[list]
[*]Blacklist and whitelist moved from left category list to top-right as independent category buttons.[/*]
[*]Each button has its own enable/disable checkbox.[/*]
[*]Left-click backpack items to add; left/right-click list items to remove.[/*]
[/list]3. Custom Category & Custom List
[list]
[*]New "Custom" category added to the left category list for centralized storage of user-specified items.[/*]
[*]New "Custom List" button at top-right for managing the item ID list allowed into the custom category.[/*]
[*]Only items in the custom list can be deposited into the "Custom" category.[/*]
[*]Custom category has its own auto-deposit checkbox.[/*]
[/list]4. Search Functionality
[list]
[*]Search box added to the top-left of the item grid.[/*]
[*]Real-time filtering by item name or ID.[/*]
[*]Press ESC to clear the search box.[/*]
[*]Decorative border and placeholder text with multi-language support.[/*]
[/list]5. One-Click All-of-Type Deposit/Withdraw
[list]
[*]Keyboard: Hold Ctrl + Left-click on space items → withdraw all of that type; on backpack items → deposit all of that type.[/*]
[*]Gamepad: Press X button (withdraw when focused on space grid, deposit when focused on backpack).[/*]
[/list]6. Multi-Language Support
[list]
[*]All new UI text has both Chinese and English translations.[/*]
[/list][heading]📖 模组介绍[/heading]
[b]PersonalDimension（随身空间）[/b] 是一个《星露谷物语》模组，为玩家提供了一个[b]无限存储空间[/b]，并且会自动将物品按类别分类存放。无论你在游戏世界的哪个角落——农场、矿井、沙漠、海岛，甚至是节日现场，都可以随时打开这个空间，轻松存取物品。
✨ 主要特性
[list]
[*][b]无限存储空间[/b]：不受容量限制，所有物品均可存放，告别箱子不够用的烦恼。[/*]
[*][b]自动分类存放[/b]：物品会根据其类型自动归类到对应的分类中，管理更高效。[/*]
[*][b]一键存取[/b]：左键从空间取出整组物品，右键取出单个物品；点击背包物品即可存入空间，操作直观流畅。[/*]
[*][b]随时随地打开[/b]：物品随身携带，右键点击即可在任何地点打开空间界面。[/*]
[*][b]联机共享[/b]：在同一存档中，所有玩家的空间[b]共享[/b]——你可以放进去，队友也能取出来，合作更便捷。[/*]
[*][b]丰富分类[/b]：支持作物（含花、蜂蜜）、种子、鱼（含鱼籽）、工匠、工具、服饰、武器、家具、制造品、资源等，物品一目了然。[/*]
[*][b]翻页与悬停[/b]：支持滚轮翻页和按钮翻页，悬停物品可查看详细信息。[/*]
[*][b]获取方式[/b]：在[b]耕种等级 5[/b] 后解锁配方，消耗 [b]5 个五彩碎片 + 100 个铱锭[/b] 制作。[/*]
[/list]📦 合成配方


[table][tr][th]材料[/th]
[th]数量[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]五彩碎片[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]铱锭[/td]
[td]100[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][b]解锁条件[/b]：耕种等级 5
🎮 使用方法
[list=1]
[*]在背包合成界面制作「随身空间」。[/*]
[*]在背包中[b]右键点击[/b]该物品，打开空间界面。[/*]
[*]左侧选择分类，查看对应物品。[/*]
[*]左键点击空间物品 → 整组取出；右键 → 取出单个。[/*]
[*]点击背包中的物品 → 自动存入空间并归类。[/*]
[*]使用滚轮或翻页按钮切换页面。[/*]
[/list]🌐 多语言支持
[list]
[*]简体中文[/*]
[*]English[/*]
[/list]🎉 本次更新内容
1. 界面优化
[list]
[*][b]物品格子背景[/b]：为空间物品添加了深色半透明背景框，视觉上更清晰，与原版背包风格统一。[/*]
[*][b]可调整的格子布局[/b]：支持自定义每行显示的物品数量（默认12列），方便不同屏幕尺寸的玩家调整。[/*]
[*][b]页码显示与翻页按钮[/b]：支持鼠标滚轮翻页和点击按钮翻页，并显示当前页码/总页数。[/*]
[*][b]标签文字居中[/b]：分类按钮文字居中显示，更美观。[/*]
[/list]2. 一键操作
[list]
[*][b]一键存入[/b]：将当前分类下所有背包物品存入空间（黑名单物品除外）。[/*]
[*][b]一键取出[/b]：将当前分类下所有空间物品取出到背包（直到背包满）。[/*]
[*][b]一键操作位置[/b]：一键存入按钮位于背包右上角，一键取出按钮位于空间网格右下角，互不干扰。[/*]
[/list]3. 自动存入功能
[list]
[*][b]分类级自动存入[/b]：每个分类可独立开启自动存入（勾选框控制）。[/*]
[*][b]佩戴戒指也可自动存入[/b]：即使不携带随身空间物品，佩戴次元戒指时自动存入功能同样生效。[/*]
[*][b]自动存入拦截[/b]：从空间取出物品时不会触发自动存入，避免死循环。[/*]
[*][b]黑名单拦截[/b]：黑名单中的物品不会被自动存入、一键存入或手动存入。[/*]
[/list]4. 黑名单系统
[list]
[*][b]独立标签页[/b]：黑名单作为独立分类显示在分类列表最下方。[/*]
[*][b]加入黑名单[/b]：切换到黑名单标签页，左键点击背包中的物品即可将其加入黑名单（仅记录信息，不消耗物品）。[/*]
[*][b]移除黑名单[/b]：在黑名单标签页中，右键点击黑名单物品即可移除。[/*]
[*][b]全局拦截[/b]：黑名单中的物品无法通过任何方式存入空间（自动存入、一键存入、手动存入均被拦截）。[/*]
[/list]5. 次元戒指
[list]
[*][b]新增物品[/b]：合成配方为 4 个铱环 + 1 个随身空间，耕种等级 5 解锁。[/*]
[*][b]佩戴效果[/b]：佩戴后可通过热键（默认 Ctrl+V）打开随身空间，无需手持随身空间物品。[/*]
[*][b]右键使用[/b]：在背包中右键点击戒指可直接打开空间（不会装备戒指）。[/*]
[*][b]自动存入支持[/b]：佩戴戒指时，自动存入功能同样生效（需开启对应分类的自动存入）。[/*]
[*][b]快捷键切换[/b]：热键可开关空间菜单（再次按下热键关闭空间）。[/*]
[/list]6. 可配置热键
[list]
[*]支持通过 
[code]config.json[/code] 文件自定义热键和修饰键（Ctrl/Shift/Alt）。[/*]
[*]默认热键为 
[code]Ctrl+V[/code]，避免与游戏内置快捷键冲突。[/*]
[/list]7. 兼容性与优化
[list]
[*]修复了物品数量重复显示的问题。[/*]
[*]修复了物品框不完整的问题。[/*]
[*]修复了自动存入导致物品被循环存入的问题。[/*]
[*]修复了戒指右键无法打开空间的问题。[/*]
[*]修复了热键被游戏拦截的问题。[/*]
[*]优化了物品分类逻辑（新增服饰、资源等分类）。[/*]
[/list][heading]🎮 按键总览[/heading]


[table][tr][th]按键[/th]
[th]功能[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]LB + A（同时按下）[/b][/td]

[td]物品网格翻页（下一页）[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][heading]🍳 烹饪与制造界面的联动机制[/heading]
在打开 [b]烹饪界面[/b] 或 [b]制造界面[/b] 时，模组会[b]自动检测[/b]您的个人空间中是否有当前配方所需的材料。
[list]
[*]如果背包中材料不足，系统会自动从个人空间中[b]补充缺失的材料[/b]。[/*]
[*]整个过程[b]无需任何额外按键操作[/b]，完全自动完成。[/*]
[*]您只需像往常一样选择配方并制作，模组会在后台智能处理材料来源。[/*]
[*]它现在已经连接了建造空间，空间里的物品会自动满足建造要求，虽然显示是红色数字，但是是能够建造的[/*]
[/list]新增功能
1. 白名单系统
[list]
[*]新增完整的白名单功能，支持白名单模式开关。[/*]
[*]白名单独立于黑名单运作，可单独启用/禁用。[/*]
[*]白名单模式开启时，仅白名单中的物品会被自动存入。[/*]
[/list]2. 黑白名单独立UI
[list]
[*]黑名单、白名单从左侧分类列表移至右上角，以独立类别按钮呈现。[/*]
[*]每个按钮配有独立的启用/禁用复选框。[/*]
[*]列表操作：左键点击背包物品添加，左键/右键点击列表物品移除。[/*]
[/list]3. 自定义分类与自定义名单
[list]
[*]左侧新增“自定义”分类，用于集中存放玩家指定的物品。[/*]
[*]右上角新增“自定义名单”按钮，用于管理允许存入自定义分类的物品ID列表。[/*]

[/list]4. 搜索功能
[list]

[*]搜索框带装饰边框和占位提示，支持多语言。[/*]
[/list]5. 一键存取同类物品
[list]
[*]键盘：按住 Ctrl + 左键点击空间物品 → 取出所有同类物品；点击背包物品 → 存入所有同类物品。[/*]

[/list]6. 多语言支持
[list]
[*]所有新增UI文案均已添加中英文翻译。[/*]
[/list]
